title: ChatGPT Can Now Make GIFs 🤯 (Images 2.6)
description:
OpenAI just released Images 2.6 for ChatGPT. You can now turn a text prompt or a photo into an animated GIF, change its speed, edit single frames, and save reference images so ChatGPT remembers a face or mascot. OpenAI also says images now generate about 50% faster.

Rolling out now in ChatGPT and Codex. Would you try it? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: OpenAI, "Introducing Images 2.6" (November 4, 2026)

#ChatGPT #OpenAI #AItools #AInews #Shorts
